title: Screen for ideas where people pay to save, share or team up
ask: Next idea screens target jobs where the paid tools charge for saved work across devices, sharing and team use, served at Rs 0 on free tiers the company already uses (Vercel Blob), with the free single-user tool still live within 48 hours
why: On 21 Nov 2026 Research screened 25 bigger ideas under the owner's new screen and none passed: 24 failed because a free no-signup browser tool already does the single-session job (company/log/research.company.json). The paid tools that clear Rs 500 a month charge for saving, sharing and teams, which a client-only page cannot offer.

options.option: Do nothing for now: keep screening only client-side, no-account tools
options.basis: 25 of 25 candidates failed on 21 Nov, plus about 25 more on the earlier screen the same day (company/log/research.company.json). No honest profit figure; the evidence says this path stays empty.

options.option: Screen for jobs where paid tools charge for saved work, sharing and team use, built at Rs 0 on free tiers already in use (Vercel Blob), free single-user tool first
options.basis: Paid tools in the failed niches sell exactly these features: StudioBinder USD 29 to 99 a month for production paperwork (https://www.studiobinder.com/pricing/), SiteSetu Rs 2,500 per project a month for contractor billing (https://sitesetu.app/pricing), Travefy USD 39 a month (https://travefy.com/pricing). The company already stores data on Vercel Blob (config.answersBlobBase) at no cost. Realism 4 not 5: storing user work needs a privacy note and the least data possible, checked by Security and Legal. No honest profit figure until an idea is sized.

options.option: Move screening to Hindi and other non-English searches where free tools are thinner
options.basis: Not yet measured: no sourced volumes for Hindi buyer terms were pulled this cycle, and willingness to pay Rs 500 a month is lower in that audience. Can be tried later as a second screen.

decision.choice: Screen for jobs where paid tools charge for saved work, sharing and team use, built at Rs 0 on free tiers already in use (Vercel Blob), free single-user tool first
decision.reason: Same zero cost and fully reversible as doing nothing, but it aims at the one gap the free no-signup tools leave open, which is what the paid products in these niches actually charge for. Doing nothing has produced no passing idea in about 50 screens today.
